proposals.summary: Pre-position buses before the stadium exit and add a bounded queue-relief hold at Old Main, keeping the 2/2/2 allocation and terminal headway hold.
proposals.rationale: The champion's biggest losses are left-behind riders at Old Main (Routes 1 and 3) and Central Station during stadium_exit, when the advertised event is known in advance. A terminal rule that dispatches early when the event is imminent should pre-stage capacity toward the surge, and a short stop-level hold at Old Main should let the worst queue drain without breaking headways. Both changes are bounded by maxHoldS and the 180 s per-loop budget, so they cannot create long service gaps. Changes: Add a terminal pre-stage rule: when event_in_s is small, dispatch immediately instead of holding for headway; Add a bounded queue-relief hold at Old Main when the local queue is large and the next bus is still far; Keep allocation at 2/2/2 and retain the existing even-headway terminal rule.

proposals.summary: Keep 2/2/2 buses and terminal headway hold, but hold buses at rail stops when a train is arriving and riders are transferring, and add a bounded Old Main queue-relief hold.
proposals.rationale: The champion misses 633 train-bus connections and leaves 1,863 riders behind, especially on Route 3 at Old Main (peak queue 229) and at Central Station for Route 2. A short, bounded hold at rail stops when the train is imminent and transfers are expected should convert missed connections into successful transfers without starving other stops. A separate queue-relief hold at Old Main targets the largest left-behind cluster while staying within the 180 s per-loop hold budget. Changes: Add a rail-stop transfer hold: if train_eta_s <= 60, expected_transfers >= 8, and headway_behind_s >= 180, hold up to 45 s; Add an Old Main queue-relief hold: if queue_here >= 25 and headway_behind_s >= 240, hold up to 30 s; Keep allocation 2/2/2, maxHoldS 60, trainDefaultDwellS 45, and the even-headway terminal rule unchanged.

proposals.summary: Keep the 2/2/2 allocation but tighten terminal spacing, add a short queue-aware stop hold for early buses, and hold R2 at Central for inbound train transfers.
proposals.rationale: Findings show Old Main and Central queues and train-to-R2 missed transfers dominate stadium_exit, while the champion's single terminal hold leaves buses bunching and does nothing to keep an early bus from leaving a big queue. Lowering r1/r2 target headways to 300s keeps same-route buses evenly spaced and shortens the Old Main and Central service gaps, and a bounded stop-level hold lets an early bus wait briefly when it faces a large queue without long onboard delay. A targeted R2 hold at Central only when a train is imminent and transfers are high should convert the 94 missed train-to-R2 connections into boardings, cutting J in stadium_exit without risking long service gaps. Changes: Set targetHeadwayS r1=300, r2=300, r3=330 to reduce bunching and Old Main/Central gaps; Add 'spacing-relief' stop rule: hold up to 20s when headway_ratio < 0.7 and queue_here >= 12; Add 'train-connect-r2' terminal rule: hold for target headway at Central when expected transfers are high and headway behind is large.
